steps.title: Prepare CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV with headers: Source Column, Source Aspiration Height from Bottom, Volume Aspirated, Volume Dispensed. Fill each row with the column number, aspiration height in mm, aspirated volume in µL, and dispensed volume in µL (e.g., 1,1,40,12). Save the file for upload.

steps.title: Configure robot deck and pipette
steps.instruction: Load the P300 Multi‑GEN2 pipette on the specified mount side. Place the source plate in Slot 1, Destination Plate 1 in Slot 4, Destination Plate 2 in Slot 7, and Destination Plate 3 in Slot 10. Set the dispense height (mm above well bottom), aspirate speed (µL/sec), and dispense speed (µL/sec) as desired.

steps.title: Iterate over CSV rows
steps.instruction: For each row in the uploaded CSV, perform the following actions:

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the specified Volume Aspirated (µL) from the indicated Source Column at the Source Aspiration Height from Bottom (mm) using the 8‑channel P300.
Dispense the specified Volume Dispensed (µL) into the same column of Destination Plate 1 (Slot 4) at the set dispense height.
Dispense the same Volume Dispensed (µL) into the same column of Destination Plate 2 (Slot 7) at the set dispense height.
Dispense the same Volume Dispensed (µL) into the same column of Destination Plate 3 (Slot 10) at the set dispense height.
